messages.author: 9e013c0be2d1e71e
messages.subject: Basal HLM with Lavaan
parts:
Dear all,

Say I only want to calculate the ICC for the basal model using lavaan two-level features. What would be the model syntax?
Say my whitin level factor is

#whitin
wf =~ x1+x2+x3

and the cluster="country"

should the between syntax for the basal model (just to calculate the ICC) be:
#between
wf ~ 1

Thanks!

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Basal HLM with Lavaan
parts:
If you want the ICC of the latent common factor, then the latent scales need to be equated by equating factor loadings across levels.  

https://doi.org/10.3389/fpsyg.2017.01640

I would then label the factor variance at each level, to place a constraint that they sum to one (thus, the between variance is the ICC).

But only estimate the indicator intercepts at Level-2, not the factor intercept.
